system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

While you are in your Flash state and you make an attack, you can spend one superiority die. When you do, you can select a number of creatures other than your original target equal to the result of your superiority die. Make a single unarmed or weapon attack against each as you teleport between each striking them before returning to your current position.
